comparison.objective: Lower a glovebox past two sprung stops, replace a keyed cabin filter, and latch the glovebox back up.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual squeezing/latching plus extraction and deep keyed-slot insertion through constrained access.
comparison.success_condition: Old filter safely removed, new filter seated within position/orientation tolerances, glovebox restored on both stops, all released; broken stops or dropped filters invalidate.
comparison.reason: This tests simultaneous compliant-stop release and long keyed insertion. It has no intentional impact fracture, struck mandrel, retained threaded insert, or loose-fragment search and containment.
